questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

Avika found this shell at the Puri beach.

options.text: This shell was found by Avika at the Puri beach.
Avika was found by this shell at the Puri beach.
This shell has been found by Avika at the Puri beach.
This shell found Avika at the Puri beach.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**This shell was found by Avika at the Puri beach**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and 'Avika' is the subject and 'this shell' is the object.
 
• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject 'Avika' of the active voice becomes the object, the object 'this shell' becomes the subject.
 
• The passive format "'was + V3 (found)" should be used.
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1*.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

 Present Simple

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

options.text: Kavya says that I make a new painting.
Kavya said that she have made a new painting.
Kavya said that she had made a new painting.

questions.solution:

• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas and inverted commas are removed, and "that'' is added.
 
• The **first-person pronoun 'I'** is converted into the **third-person pronoun 'she'**.
